translationRepairs: His wife, as her own daughter could not bear children, obtained the lady and cherished her more than a birth child; nurse and tutor instructed her, and her deportment was fully complete.
His wife, who had no daughter that lived, obtained the lady and cherished her more than a birth child; nurse and tutor instructed her, and her deportment was fully complete.
s0071 息女不育 means the wife had no surviving/raised daughter of her own, not that a daughter was infertile; the proposal’s parenthetical hedge is awkward, so a single clean rendering is used.
His wife, who had no children of her own, took her in and loved her more than a daughter of her own blood; nurses and tutors trained her until her manners were flawless.
His wife, who had no daughter of her own that lived, took her in and loved her more than a birth child; nurses and tutors trained her until her manners were flawless.
s0071 specifies 息女, a daughter; ‘no children’ overgeneralizes, and ‘no daughter … that lived’ restores the Chinese scope while keeping natural idiomatic English.
After he took the throne he posthumously invested her as Honored Consort and proclaimed mourning, which is why Shizong later issued an order for him to leave mourning.
After he took the throne he posthumously invested her as Honored Consort and proclaimed mourning; therefore there was an order for Shizong to leave mourning and resume office.
故世宗有起復之命 means Shizong was the one ordered to leave mourning and resume office; the prior English wrongly makes Shizong the issuer of an order for Taizu.
